    - "Monitor weight gain trajectory with OB and adjust calories as needed"
    - "Prioritise protein distribution: ~20-40g protein per meal"
    - "Post-workout: 20-30g protein + some carbs to aid recovery"
    - "Food safety: avoid high-mercury fish and unpasteurised products"

    - "Iron supplementation only if deficient or prescribed"
    - "Omega-3 (DHA) 200..300 mg/day from supplement if fish intake low"

    - "Use submaximal testing and prediction methods to gauge strength while keeping intensity safe."

  SUBMAX_ALTERNATIVES:
    - "5RM or 3RM tests at RPE <=8 with controlled technique; estimate 1RM from these using validated equations."
    - "Repeated-effort sets: e.g., work up to a heavy set of 3-5 reps (RPE 8) with full bracing but avoid maximal Valsalva and breath-holding."
    - "Velocity or RPE-based autoregulation: track RPE and bar speed across sessions to infer changes without a true maximal attempt."
    - "Use higher-rep performance (e.g., AMRAP at a fixed submax weight for 6-10 reps) and convert to estimated 1RM."

    - "Avoid supine positions after week 16 — perform pressing variations seated/incline/standing rather than flat supine testing."
